title: MetallicsArtsForBetaTesters
description: A small modpack based on Metallics Arts with mandatory and optional mods to test new changes in betas before the different releases.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfc0cd72ee4878d54b929d9018987f2fe54278b3.png)

Test modpack focused on testing the functionality by our community of the Metallics Arts mod in a controlled Minecraft environment.


⚠️ Warning: This is a testing environment. Bugs, frequent changes, and possible instability are expected. ⚠️


## Purpose:

**This modpack is specifically designed to:**

- Test and report bugs in Metallics Arts beta versions
- Evaluate the balance of Allomancy, Feruchemy, and -Hemalurgy mechanics
- Test compatibility with recent versions of Minecraft/Forge
- Identify performance and optimization issues
- Verify the integration of recipes and mod progression

## Mod List:

- Metallics Arts
- Curios API
- Caelus API
- GeckoLib
- Modonomicon
- JEI
- Jade
- Xaeros World Map
- Rubidium
- Oculus
- AppleSkin
- Iris/Oculus & Geckolib Compat


## Want to contribute?

Use this modpack, and report bugs or suggestions by joining our Discord or directly on GitHub!


## About Us:

SteelCodeTeam is an independent development group composed of a core team of three people, plus many other occasional collaborators.

Stay tuned for the latest updates or install guides on our social media!

We sincerely hope you enjoy your trip with us! 🎉
